title: Mechanical Marie
description: Former martial arts legend Marie has accepted a new job as a “mechanical maid”… except she’s 100% human, and Arthur, her new boss, despises humans. Luckily, Marie’s naturally expressionless face helps her keep up the robot act while secretly protecting Arthur from constant assassination attempts. But when Arthur falls in love with his “perfect” maid, things quickly spiral out of control!

episodes_data.title: Mechanical Marie Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: The misanthropic heir to a corporate empire loves his new robot maid. One small problem: she's secretly human.

episodes_data.title: Mechanical Marie Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Marie grows flustered around Arthur, and he realizes something is up. How much longer can her secret keep?

episodes_data.title: Mechanical Marie Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Marie struggles to act out a convincing "Girlfriend Mode" for Arthur and runs afoul of a wily new assassin.

episodes_data.title: Mechanical Marie Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Arthur refuses to rest despite a bad cold. Marie tries to help and confronts her feelings in the process.

episodes_data.title: Mechanical Marie Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Marie struggles to keep her cool around Arthur now that she realizes how she feels about him.

episodes_data.title: Mechanical Marie Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Arthur's birthday sneaks up on Marie. When he reveals he loathes the day, she sets out to make it a happy one.

episodes_data.title: Mechanical Marie Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: A boy named Daryl introduces himself as misanthropic Arthur's best friend. What is their connection really?

episodes_data.title: Mechanical Marie Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Arthur kicks off summer break by taking Marie to a tropical island, but private moments prove hard to come by.

episodes_data.title: Mechanical Marie Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: With Arthur busy, Marie tries to befriend his fan club, but her plans to win them over soon misfire.

episodes_data.title: Mechanical Marie Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Arthur is committed to keeping Marie's secret, but acting as oblivious as he used to proves a tall order.

episodes_data.title: Mechanical Marie Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Any pretense of secrecy ends when Arthur and Marie get locked in the bath together.

episodes_data.title: Mechanical Marie Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Marie infiltrates Maynard's mansion in search of an antidote to the poison that took Arthur's memory.
